children.value: Saturday, July 11, 2026, 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM, Cambridgeport, Cambridge MA. A neighborhood-wide day of free porch concerts.

Scraped today from cambridgeport.org/porchfestmaps and the City of Cambridge's public ArcGIS Porchfest dashboard feature layer, which carries exact GPS points for each performance. Regenerate with apps/porchfest/pipeline/build.py.

Coordinates are the ArcGIS dashboard's own points, published by the organizers for this event — not independently geocoded, so a few porches may sit slightly off if the source point does. A handful of slots may be missing a pin if a row didn't carry a location.
Blue = 12 PM · teal = 1 PM · green = 2 PM · amber = 3 PM · coral = 4 PM · red = 5 PM.
